FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_SubseaRiser_BuoyancyStressTelemetry
(*
========================================================================================================================
  PROJECT      : ULTRA-DEEPWATER DYNAMIC DRILLING & PRODUCTION MARINE RISER SYSTEM (3,000m WD)
  SUBSYSTEM    : DISTRIBUTED BUOYANCY MODULE (DBM) NITROGEN PRE-CHARGE & IN-LINE BENDING STRESS TELEMETRY
  DESIGNATION  : SIL-3 / API RP 2RD / API SPEC 16Q / DNV-OS-F201 SUBSEA CYBER-PHYSICAL OBSERVATION SYSTEM
  SPECIFICATION: IEC 61131-3 3RD EDITION / ISA-18.2 ALARM MANAGEMENT / HIGH-INTEGRITY SENSOR VOTING
  AUTHOR       : PRINCIPAL AUTOMATION FELLOW & CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS CHAIR (LUMINA SWARM)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEM & CONTINUUM MECHANICS FOUNDATIONS:
    1. THERMODYNAMIC GAS-BUOYANCY EQUILIBRIUM IN DEEPWATER ENVIRONMENTS:
       In deep and ultra-deepwater drilling (operating at water depths up to 3,500 m, where ambient hydrostatic pressure
       exceeds 350 bar and seabed temperatures hover between 1.5 deg C and 4.0 deg C), composite Distributed Buoyancy
       Modules (DBMs) provide the necessary axial up-thrust to prevent riser buckling and reduce top tensioner loading.
       Advanced variable or pressure-balanced syntactic/gas hybrid modules utilize an internal nitrogen (N2) pre-charge
       cushion. The thermodynamic state of the nitrogen chamber follows the real-gas equation of state:
           P_N2 * V_chamber = Z(P, T) * n * R_gas * T_kelvin
       where Z(P,T) is the compressibility factor modeled via a truncated Peng-Robinson / Beattie-Bridgeman correlation.
       The net effective buoyancy uplift force F_buoy [kN] exerted on the riser joint is governed by Archimedes' principle
       adjusted for gas compression, thermal contraction, and external hydrostatic water column head:
           P_hydro = rho_seawater * g_accel * h_depth * 1.0E-5  [bar]
           F_buoy  = (rho_seawater * V_displaced * g_accel - M_module * g_accel - M_N2 * g_accel) * 1.0E-3 [kN]
       Any loss of nitrogen pre-charge pressure indicates micro-cracking, seal extrusion, or diaphragm rupture,
       precipitating rapid syntactic foam hydro-elastic collapse, catastrophic negative buoyancy surge, and severe
       over-tensioning of the floating offshore rig's hydropneumatic tensioner cylinders.

    2. BEAM-COLUMN MECHANICS & COMPOSITE MULTI-AXIS STRESS INTEGRATION:
       The marine riser behaves as an ultra-slender, tensioned beam-column subjected to non-linear hydrodynamic drag,
       current-induced vortex shedding, top vessel surge/heave motion, and internal multiphase mud density gradients:
           E*I * (d^4 y / dz^4) - d/dz [ T_eff(z) * (dy / dz) ] + m_riser * (d^2 y / dt^2) = F_mordison(z, t)
       The in-line strain telemetry node captures orthogonal bending stresses (sigma_bx, sigma_by) via triaxial Fiber
       Bragg Grating (FBG) optical sensors and hermetic piezoresistive bridge arrays. The axial stress sigma_axial and
       hydrostatic/mud internal-external hoop stresses sigma_hoop are synthesized to evaluate the complete multi-axial
       von Mises equivalent stress envelope:
           sigma_bend_mag = SQRT(sigma_bx^2 + sigma_by^2)
           sigma_axial    = (T_top_effective + M_subsea_apparent) / A_steel_wall
           sigma_hoop     = (P_internal_mud * D_inner - P_hydro_seawater * D_outer) / (2.0 * t_wall)
           sigma_vonMises = SQRT( sigma_axial^2 + sigma_hoop^2 - (sigma_axial * sigma_hoop) + 3.0 * tau_torsion^2 + sigma_bend_mag^2 )
       Design utilization ratio eta_stress is monitored against API RP 2RD Allowable Stress Design (ASD) criteria:
           eta_stress = sigma_vonMises / (C_design * SMYS)
       where SMYS = Specified Minimum Yield Strength (e.g. 555.0 MPa for DNV Grade UXT-80 riser pipe steel).

    3. STATE-SPACE FORMULATION & DISCRETE OBSERVER / MODEL PREDICTIVE FEEDFORWARD (MPC):
       To predict riser deflection, curvature limits, and fatigue damage under high loop-current surges, the subsea
       telemetry controller implements a 4th-order discretized linear state-space observer:
           x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k] + L_obs * (y_meas[k] - C_d * x[k])
           y_est[k] = C_d * x[k]
       State Vector:
           x[0] = Delta_P_N2 : Pre-charge pressure deviation from isobaric baseline [bar]
           x[1] = dP_N2/dt   : Nitrogen leakage / pressure depletion rate [bar/s]
           x[2] = sigma_b    : Composite in-line bending stress [MPa]
           x[3] = d_theta/dt : Subsea inclinometer angular angular velocity [deg/s]
       The Model Predictive Control (MPC) feedforward block computes dynamic top-tension trim commands to keep the Lower
       Flex Joint (LFJ) and Upper Flex Joint (UFJ) angular excursions within strict API 16Q limits (< 2.5 deg operating,
       < 4.0 deg disconnect threshold).

    4. HIGH-INTEGRITY 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING:
       The nitrogen gas pre-charge is monitored by three independent, isolation-valved pressure transducers (Ch-A, Ch-B,
       Ch-C) rated for subsea hyperbaric immersion. A rigorous 2oo3 voting engine executes cross-channel differential checks,
       drift rate diagnostics, and out-of-range clamp monitoring. The engine automatically degrades to 2oo2 upon a single
       channel failure, to 1oo1 upon dual failure, and defaults to a verified physical hydrodynamic state estimator when
       all direct transducers fail.

    5. ISA-18.2 ALARM TREES & FIRST-OUT EMERGENCY DISCONNECT SEQUENCE (EDS):
       Integrates deterministic trip conditions, priority shelving, fatigue life cycle damage accumulation via Palmgren-Miner
       linear damage rules, and provides first-out interlocks for the Emergency Disconnect System (EDS).
========================================================================================================================
*)

VAR_INPUT
    (* --- Master Permissives & Operation Mode Commands --- *)
    bSystemEnable                   : BOOL;     (* Master subsea telemetry and observer enable signal [TRUE=Active] *)
    bEStopDisconnectPermissive      : BOOL;     (* Hardwired SIL-3 emergency quick-disconnect (EQD) loop [TRUE=Healthy] *)
    bAutoTensionerTrimEnable        : BOOL;     (* Closed-loop Model Predictive Control top-tension trim permissive *)
    bZeroCalibrationRequest         : BOOL;     (* Command pulse to perform hyperbaric hydrostatic baseline zeroing *)

    (* --- Redundant Buoyancy Module Nitrogen Pressure Transducers --- *)
    rN2Pressure_TransducerA_bar     : REAL;     (* N2 pre-charge pressure transducer Ch-A [bar] (0.0 .. 600.0) *)
    rN2Pressure_TransducerB_bar     : REAL;     (* N2 pre-charge pressure transducer Ch-B [bar] (0.0 .. 600.0) *)
    rN2Pressure_TransducerC_bar     : REAL;     (* N2 pre-charge pressure transducer Ch-C [bar] (0.0 .. 600.0) *)

    (* --- Subsea Hydrostatic & Oceanographic Inputs --- *)
    rAmbientHydrostaticPress_bar    : REAL;     (* External ambient seawater hydrostatic pressure [bar] (0.0 .. 450.0) *)
    rRiserWaterDepth_m              : REAL;     (* Subsea telemetry node installation depth [m] (0.0 .. 3500.0) *)
    rSeawaterTemperature_DegC       : REAL;     (* Subsea ambient seawater temperature [deg C] (-2.0 .. 35.0) *)
    rInternalMudDensity_sg          : REAL;     (* Drilling fluid / completion brine specific gravity [sg] (0.9 .. 2.5) *)

    (* --- In-Line Structural & Kinematic Sensor Telemetry --- *)
    rBendingStress_SensorX_MPa      : REAL;     (* In-line primary bending stress along vessel surge/X-axis [MPa] (-450.0 .. 450.0) *)
    rBendingStress_SensorY_MPa      : REAL;     (* In-line secondary bending stress along vessel sway/Y-axis [MPa] (-450.0 .. 450.0) *)
    rRiserTopTension_kN             : REAL;     (* Dynamic riser top tension at surface tensioner ring [kN] (0.0 .. 15000.0) *)
    rInclinometerAngle_deg          : REAL;     (* Subsea joint triaxial inclinometer deflection angle [deg] (0.0 .. 25.0) *)
    rDrillStringWeight_kN           : REAL;     (* Internal drill string hanging weight transmitted to riser [kN] (0.0 .. 8000.0) *)

    (* --- Telemetry Telecommunications Diagnostics --- *)
    bAcousticTelemetryLinkOk        : BOOL;     (* Subsea acoustic / umbilical high-speed data link integrity [TRUE=Valid] *)
    rTelemetryBitErrorRate_Pct      : REAL;     (* Acoustic / optical communication channel packet loss / BER [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- Supervisory Status & System Health --- *)
    bSystemReady                    : BOOL;     (* Telemetry, state estimator, and voting cores online and verified *)
    bDegradedModeActive             : BOOL;     (* Operating under degraded sensor redundancy or high BER conditions *)
    bEmergencyDisconnectAdvisory    : BOOL;     (* SIL-3 immediate riser EDS unlatch advisory command to DP vessel *)

    (* --- Voted Physical & Structural Telemetry Values --- *)
    rVotedN2Pressure_bar            : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated nitrogen module pre-charge pressure [bar] *)
    rDifferentialPressure_bar       : REAL;     (* Bladder differential pressure: Voted N2 - Ambient Hydrostatic [bar] *)
    rNetBuoyancyUplift_kN           : REAL;     (* Calculated net active buoyancy uplift force per riser joint [kN] *)
    rTotalBendingStress_MPa         : REAL;     (* Magnitude of resultant multi-axis in-line bending stress [MPa] *)
    rVonMisesEquivalentStress_MPa   : REAL;     (* Composite equivalent stress: axial tension + bending + hoop [MPa] *)
    rStressUtilization_Pct          : REAL;     (* API RP 2RD / DNV allowable yield strength utilization [%] (0.0 .. 150.0) *)

    (* --- Dynamic Control Commands & Prognostics --- *)
    rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN   : REAL;     (* MPC feedforward top-tension adjustment trim request [kN] *)
    rCumulativeFatigueDamage_Miner  : REAL;     (* Accumulated Palmgren-Miner cyclic bending fatigue damage ratio [0.0 .. 1.0] *)

    (* --- Diagnostics and Alarms --- *)
    wAlarmWord                      : WORD;     (* ISA-18.2 packed alarm word: Bit0=CritDiscon, Bit1=Yield, Bit2=N2Loss... *)
    wSystemStatusWord               : WORD;     (* Diagnostic and state machine status indicator word *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- State Machine Registers --- *)
    iState                          : INT := 0; (* Current operational state index *)
    iPrevState                      : INT := 0; (* Previous operational state index *)

    (* --- Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Validation Core --- *)
    bSensorA_Valid                  : BOOL := TRUE;
    bSensorB_Valid                  : BOOL := TRUE;
    bSensorC_Valid                  : BOOL := TRUE;
    iHealthySensorCount             : INT  := 3;
    rDeltaAB                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaBC                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaCA                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rTmrToleranceLimit_bar          : REAL := 12.5; (* Maximum tolerable inter-transducer divergence [bar] *)
    rSensorMinBound_bar             : REAL := 10.0; (* Transducer lower electrical saturation limit [bar] *)
    rSensorMaxBound_bar             : REAL := 580.0;(* Transducer upper electrical saturation limit [bar] *)

    (* --- Discrete State-Space Model Representation (dt = 0.10 s) --- *)
    (* State Vector x:
         x[0] = Delta_P_N2 : Nitrogen pressure deviation from baseline [bar]
         x[1] = dP_N2/dt   : Nitrogen leak rate / pressure decay rate [bar/s]
         x[2] = sigma_b    : Filtered dynamic bending stress magnitude [MPa]
         x[3] = omega_tilt : Rate of change of riser joint tilt [deg/s]
    *)
    rState_x1_DeltaPN2              : REAL := 0.0;
    rState_x2_LeakRate              : REAL := 0.0;
    rState_x3_BendingStress         : REAL := 0.0;
    rState_x4_TiltRate              : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Discretized Plant Matrices A_d and B_d (Euler discretization at 100ms) *)
    rA11 : REAL := 0.9995;  rA12 : REAL := 0.0985;  rB11 : REAL := -0.0012;
    rA21 : REAL := -0.0002; rA22 : REAL := 0.9850;  rB21 : REAL := -0.0150;
    rA33 : REAL := 0.9250;  rA34 : REAL := 1.8500;  rB32 : REAL := -0.0450; (* Tensioner trim authority on stress *)
    rA43 : REAL := -0.0085; rA44 : REAL := 0.8950;  rB42 : REAL := 0.0025;

    (* Model Observer Gains (Luenberger correction vector) *)
    rL11 : REAL := 0.0850;
    rL21 : REAL := 0.0120;
    rL32 : REAL := 0.1250;
    rL43 : REAL := 0.0950;

    (* Historical Memory & Rate Derivative Accumulators *)
    rPrevN2Pressure_bar             : REAL := 320.0;
    rPrevInclinometer_deg           : REAL := 0.0;
    rPrevBendingStress_MPa          : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Physical Riser Joint Constants & Geometric Properties *)
    rRiserOuterDiameter_m           : REAL := 0.5334;   (* 21.0 inch OD API marine drilling riser pipe [m] *)
    rRiserWallThickness_m           : REAL := 0.0254;   (* 1.0 inch wall thickness [m] *)
    rSteelCrossSectionArea_m2       : REAL := 0.04054;  (* Cross-sectional steel area A_s [m2] *)
    rModuleDisplacedVolume_m3       : REAL := 2.850;    (* Single joint DBM syntactic displaced volume [m3] *)
    rModuleDryWeight_kg             : REAL := 1250.0;   (* Buoyancy module dry weight in air [kg] *)
    rSteelYieldStrength_SMYS_MPa    : REAL := 555.0;    (* DNV UXT-80 grade Specified Minimum Yield Strength [MPa] *)
    rDesignAllowableFactor          : REAL := 0.670;    (* API RP 2RD Operating Condition Design Factor (0.67*SMYS) *)
    rNominalPreCharge_bar           : REAL := 320.0;    (* Nominal workshop N2 pre-charge at 20 deg C [bar] *)

    (* Model Predictive Control Horizon & Tensioner Trim Accumulator *)
    rTargetBendingStress_MPa        : REAL := 45.0;     (* Target nominal mean bending stress [MPa] *)
    rMaxTensionerTrimAuthority_kN   : REAL := 1500.0;   (* Max allowable automated top-tension adjust [kN] *)
    rMpcProportionalGain            : REAL := 18.5;     (* Proportional feedback stiffness [kN / MPa] *)
    rMpcDerivativeGain              : REAL := 8.2;      (* Derivative damping factor [kN / (MPa/s)] *)
    rMpcBuoyancyLossCompGain        : REAL := 1.15;     (* Compensation ratio for loss of distributed uplift *)

    (* Low-Pass Filter Accumulators *)
    rHydrostatic_Filt_bar           : REAL := 0.0;
    rBendingX_Filt_MPa              : REAL := 0.0;
    rBendingY_Filt_MPa              : REAL := 0.0;
    rTopTension_Filt_kN             : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Fatigue Cycle Counting & Accumulator (Palmgren-Miner Approximation) *)
    rStressRange_Delta_MPa          : REAL := 0.0;
    rCyclesToFailure_N              : REAL := 1.0E12;
    rFatigueCurveConstant_LogA      : REAL := 12.18;   (* DNV-RP-C203 Curve D in seawater with cathodic protection *)
    rFatigueSlope_m                 : REAL := 3.0;

    (* System Timers & Hardware Watchdogs *)
    tonStartupDelay                 : TON;
    tonSensorFaultDebounce          : TON;
    tonLeakPersistenceTimer         : TON;
    tonEmergencyDisconnectTrip     : TON;

    (* Diagnostic Cycle & Telemetry Statistics *)
    udiExecutionCycles              : UDINT := 0;
    udiTelemetryDroppedPackets      : UDINT := 0;
    udiTotalStressExceedanceEvents  : UDINT := 0;
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC EXECUTION ROUTINE (SAMPLE PERIOD dt = 0.10 SECONDS / 10 Hz)
========================================================================================================================
*)

udiExecutionCycles := udiExecutionCycles + 1;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & EMERGENCY DISCONNECT SUPERVISION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEStopDisconnectPermissive THEN
    (* Hardware Emergency Quick-Disconnect (EQD) loop broken or unlatched *)
    bSystemReady                 := FALSE;
    bDegradedModeActive          := FALSE;
    bEmergencyDisconnectAdvisory := TRUE;
    rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN:= 0.0;
    wAlarmWord.0                 := TRUE;   (* First-Out: Hardwired Disconnect Loop Active *)
    wSystemStatusWord            := 16#F001;
    iState                       := 99;     (* Direct lock to Emergency Disconnect State *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

wAlarmWord.0 := FALSE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHM
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Step 2.1: Electrical / Physical Range Boundary Check [10.0 bar to 580.0 bar] *)
bSensorA_Valid := (rN2Pressure_TransducerA_bar >= rSensorMinBound_bar) AND (rN2Pressure_TransducerA_bar <= rSensorMaxBound_bar);
bSensorB_Valid := (rN2Pressure_TransducerB_bar >= rSensorMinBound_bar) AND (rN2Pressure_TransducerB_bar <= rSensorMaxBound_bar);
bSensorC_Valid := (rN2Pressure_TransducerC_bar >= rSensorMinBound_bar) AND (rN2Pressure_TransducerC_bar <= rSensorMaxBound_bar);

(* Step 2.2: Inter-Transducer Divergence Residuals *)
rDeltaAB := ABS(rN2Pressure_TransducerA_bar - rN2Pressure_TransducerB_bar);
rDeltaBC := ABS(rN2Pressure_TransducerB_bar - rN2Pressure_TransducerC_bar);
rDeltaCA := ABS(rN2Pressure_TransducerC_bar - rN2Pressure_TransducerA_bar);

(* Step 2.3: 2oo3 Voting Engine with Automatic Channel Isolation *)
IF bSensorA_Valid AND bSensorB_Valid AND bSensorC_Valid THEN
    IF (rDeltaAB <= rTmrToleranceLimit_bar) AND (rDeltaBC <= rTmrToleranceLimit_bar) AND (rDeltaCA <= rTmrToleranceLimit_bar) THEN
        (* Pristine 2oo3 Consensus: All three channels tightly aligned *)
        rVotedN2Pressure_bar := (rN2Pressure_TransducerA_bar + rN2Pressure_TransducerB_bar + rN2Pressure_TransducerC_bar) / 3.0;
        iHealthySensorCount  := 3;
        wAlarmWord.2         := FALSE; (* TMR Divergence Clear *)
    ELSIF (rDeltaAB <= rTmrToleranceLimit_bar) AND (rDeltaBC > rTmrToleranceLimit_bar) AND (rDeltaCA > rTmrToleranceLimit_bar) THEN
        (* Channel C Drifting / Failed: Isolate C, vote A and B *)
        rVotedN2Pressure_bar := (rN2Pressure_TransducerA_bar + rN2Pressure_TransducerB_bar) / 2.0;
        bSensorC_Valid       := FALSE;
        iHealthySensorCount  := 2;
        wAlarmWord.2         := TRUE;  (* Sensor C Isolated *)
    ELSIF (rDeltaBC <= rTmrToleranceLimit_bar) AND (rDeltaAB > rTmrToleranceLimit_bar) AND (rDeltaCA > rTmrToleranceLimit_bar) THEN
        (* Channel A Drifting / Failed: Isolate A, vote B and C *)
        rVotedN2Pressure_bar := (rN2Pressure_TransducerB_bar + rN2Pressure_TransducerC_bar) / 2.0;
        bSensorA_Valid       := FALSE;
        iHealthySensorCount  := 2;
        wAlarmWord.2         := TRUE;  (* Sensor A Isolated *)
    ELSIF (rDeltaCA <= rTmrToleranceLimit_bar) AND (rDeltaAB > rTmrToleranceLimit_bar) AND (rDeltaBC > rTmrToleranceLimit_bar) THEN
        (* Channel B Drifting / Failed: Isolate B, vote C and A *)
        rVotedN2Pressure_bar := (rN2Pressure_TransducerC_bar + rN2Pressure_TransducerA_bar) / 2.0;
        bSensorB_Valid       := FALSE;
        iHealthySensorCount  := 2;
        wAlarmWord.2         := TRUE;  (* Sensor B Isolated *)
    ELSE
        (* Complete 2oo3 Incoherence: Divergence across all channels *)
        rVotedN2Pressure_bar := (rN2Pressure_TransducerA_bar + rN2Pressure_TransducerB_bar + rN2Pressure_TransducerC_bar) / 3.0;
        iHealthySensorCount  := 1;
        wAlarmWord.2         := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord.3         := TRUE;  (* High Incoherence Fault *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bSensorA_Valid AND bSensorB_Valid THEN
    rVotedN2Pressure_bar := (rN2Pressure_TransducerA_bar + rN2Pressure_TransducerB_bar) / 2.0;
    iHealthySensorCount  := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2         := TRUE;
ELSIF bSensorB_Valid AND bSensorC_Valid THEN
    rVotedN2Pressure_bar := (rN2Pressure_TransducerB_bar + rN2Pressure_TransducerC_bar) / 2.0;
    iHealthySensorCount  := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2         := TRUE;
ELSIF bSensorC_Valid AND bSensorA_Valid THEN
    rVotedN2Pressure_bar := (rN2Pressure_TransducerC_bar + rN2Pressure_TransducerA_bar) / 2.0;
    iHealthySensorCount  := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2         := TRUE;
ELSIF bSensorA_Valid THEN
    rVotedN2Pressure_bar := rN2Pressure_TransducerA_bar;
    iHealthySensorCount  := 1;
    wAlarmWord.3         := TRUE;
ELSIF bSensorB_Valid THEN
    rVotedN2Pressure_bar := rN2Pressure_TransducerB_bar;
    iHealthySensorCount  := 1;
    wAlarmWord.3         := TRUE;
ELSIF bSensorC_Valid THEN
    rVotedN2Pressure_bar := rN2Pressure_TransducerC_bar;
    iHealthySensorCount  := 1;
    wAlarmWord.3         := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Total Redundancy Loss: Fall back to state-space synthetic pressure observer *)
    rVotedN2Pressure_bar := rNominalPreCharge_bar + rState_x1_DeltaPN2;
    iHealthySensorCount  := 0;
    wAlarmWord.3         := TRUE;  (* Sensor Blackout: Synthetic Estimation Engaged *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: PROCESS VARIABLE FILTERING & MULTI-AXIS CONTINUUM MECHANICS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* First-order recursive IIR filter (tau = 0.5s at 10Hz sample rate) *)
rHydrostatic_Filt_bar := (rHydrostatic_Filt_bar * 0.80) + (rAmbientHydrostaticPress_bar * 0.20);
rBendingX_Filt_MPa    := (rBendingX_Filt_MPa * 0.75) + (rBendingStress_SensorX_MPa * 0.25);
rBendingY_Filt_MPa    := (rBendingY_Filt_MPa * 0.75) + (rBendingStress_SensorY_MPa * 0.25);
rTopTension_Filt_kN   := (rTopTension_Filt_kN * 0.85) + (rRiserTopTension_kN * 0.15);

(* Differential Pressure Across Buoyancy Diaphragm [bar] *)
rDifferentialPressure_bar := rVotedN2Pressure_bar - rHydrostatic_Filt_bar;

(* Resultant In-Line Bending Stress Magnitude [MPa] *)
rTotalBendingStress_MPa := SQRT((rBendingX_Filt_MPa * rBendingX_Filt_MPa) + (rBendingY_Filt_MPa * rBendingY_Filt_MPa));

(* Net Active Buoyancy Uplift Force Per Joint [kN] *)
(* Uplift = (Displaced Seawater - Dry Weight) modified by pressure-balance ratio *)
IF rVotedN2Pressure_bar >= rHydrostatic_Filt_bar THEN
    (* Fully inflated bladder, full volume displacement *)
    rNetBuoyancyUplift_kN := ((1.025 * rModuleDisplacedVolume_m3 * 9.8066) - (rModuleDryWeight_kg * 9.8066 * 0.001));
ELSE
    (* Partial bladder collapse due to N2 depletion under hyperbaric hydrostatic head *)
    rNetBuoyancyUplift_kN := ((1.025 * rModuleDisplacedVolume_m3 * 9.8066) * (rVotedN2Pressure_bar / (rHydrostatic_Filt_bar + 0.001)))
                             - (rModuleDryWeight_kg * 9.8066 * 0.001);
    IF rNetBuoyancyUplift_kN < 0.0 THEN
        rNetBuoyancyUplift_kN := 0.0; (* Module becomes neutral or negative weight sink *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Multi-Axial Combined Stress: Axial + Hoop + Bending *)
(* 1. Nominal Axial Stress [MPa] from top tension minus submerged riser weight *)
VAR_TEMP
    rAxialStress_MPa : REAL;
    rHoopStress_MPa  : REAL;
    rMudPressure_bar : REAL;
END_VAR

rAxialStress_MPa := (rTopTension_Filt_kN * 1000.0) / (rSteelCrossSectionArea_m2 * 1.0E6);

(* 2. Lamé Hoop Stress [MPa] from internal mud column vs external seawater hydrostatic *)
rMudPressure_bar := rInternalMudDensity_sg * 0.098066 * rRiserWaterDepth_m;
rHoopStress_MPa  := ((rMudPressure_bar * (rRiserOuterDiameter_m - 2.0 * rRiserWallThickness_m) * 0.1)
                     - (rHydrostatic_Filt_bar * rRiserOuterDiameter_m * 0.1)) / (2.0 * rRiserWallThickness_m);

(* 3. Equivalent von Mises Stress Formulation [MPa] *)
rVonMisesEquivalentStress_MPa := SQRT(
    (rAxialStress_MPa * rAxialStress_MPa) +
    (rHoopStress_MPa * rHoopStress_MPa) -
    (rAxialStress_MPa * rHoopStress_MPa) +
    (rTotalBendingStress_MPa * rTotalBendingStress_MPa)
);

(* 4. Stress Utilization Ratio against API RP 2RD Design Allowable [%] *)
rStressUtilization_Pct := (rVonMisesEquivalentStress_MPa / (rDesignAllowableFactor * rSteelYieldStrength_SMYS_MPa)) * 100.0;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MPC ESTIMATION CORE
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute dynamic derivative inputs *)
rState_x2_LeakRate := (rVotedN2Pressure_bar - rPrevN2Pressure_bar) / 0.10; (* [bar/s] *)
rPrevN2Pressure_bar:= rVotedN2Pressure_bar;

rState_x4_TiltRate := (rInclinometerAngle_deg - rPrevInclinometer_deg) / 0.10; (* [deg/s] *)
rPrevInclinometer_deg := rInclinometerAngle_deg;

(* State vector update with Luenberger observer innovation injection *)
rState_x1_DeltaPN2      := (rA11 * rState_x1_DeltaPN2) + (rA12 * rState_x2_LeakRate) 
                           + rL11 * (rVotedN2Pressure_bar - rNominalPreCharge_bar - rState_x1_DeltaPN2);

rState_x3_BendingStress := (rA33 * rState_x3_BendingStress) + (rA34 * rState_x4_TiltRate)
                           + rL32 * (rTotalBendingStress_MPa - rState_x3_BendingStress);

(* Palmgren-Miner Fatigue Damage Cycle Accumulator *)
rStressRange_Delta_MPa := ABS(rTotalBendingStress_MPa - rPrevBendingStress_MPa);
rPrevBendingStress_MPa := rTotalBendingStress_MPa;

IF rStressRange_Delta_MPa > 5.0 THEN
    (* Logarithmic S-N curve inversion: log10(N) = LogA - m * log10(Delta_sigma) *)
    rCyclesToFailure_N := EXPT(10.0, (rFatigueCurveConstant_LogA - (rFatigueSlope_m * (LN(rStressRange_Delta_MPa) / 2.302585))));
    IF rCyclesToFailure_N > 1.0E4 THEN
        rCumulativeFatigueDamage_Miner := rCumulativeFatigueDamage_Miner + (1.0 / rCyclesToFailure_N);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: FINITE STATE MACHINE EXECUTION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_COLD_INIT_AND_DIAGNOSTICS: Pre-engagement communication handshake *)
        bSystemReady                 := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive          := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDisconnectAdvisory := FALSE;
        rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN:= 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord            := 16#0001;

        tonStartupDelay(IN := bSystemEnable, PT := T#5S);
        IF tonStartupDelay.Q THEN
            tonStartupDelay(IN := FALSE);
            IF bAcousticTelemetryLinkOk AND (rTelemetryBitErrorRate_Pct < 15.0) AND (iHealthySensorCount >= 2) THEN
                iState := 10; (* Advance to Hydrostatic Baseline Calibration *)
            ELSE
                wAlarmWord.4 := TRUE; (* Initialization telemetry link failure *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_HYDROSTATIC_BASELINE_ZERO: Calibrate depth tare and module equilibrium *)
        bSystemReady                 := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive          := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDisconnectAdvisory := FALSE;
        rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN:= 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord            := 16#0010;

        (* Perform tare nulling of bending residual offsets *)
        IF bZeroCalibrationRequest OR (udiExecutionCycles > 50) THEN
            rState_x1_DeltaPN2 := rVotedN2Pressure_bar - rNominalPreCharge_bar;
            iState             := 20; (* Transition to Online Normal Operation *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_ONLINE_NORMAL_TMR_ACTIVE: Closed-Loop Observation & Model Predictive Control *)
        bSystemReady                 := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive          := (iHealthySensorCount < 3) OR (rTelemetryBitErrorRate_Pct > 5.0);
        bEmergencyDisconnectAdvisory := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord            := 16#0020;

        (* Model Predictive Control: Top-Tension Trim Optimization *)
        (* Computes feedforward trim to maintain lower flex joint angle < 1.5 deg and minimize bending *)
        IF bAutoTensionerTrimEnable THEN
            rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN := (rMpcProportionalGain * (rTotalBendingStress_MPa - rTargetBendingStress_MPa))
                                           + (rMpcDerivativeGain * (rTotalBendingStress_MPa - rPrevBendingStress_MPa) / 0.10)
                                           + (rMpcBuoyancyLossCompGain * (25.0 - rNetBuoyancyUplift_kN) * 10.0);

            (* Clamp trim commands to structural envelope boundaries *)
            IF rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN > rMaxTensionerTrimAuthority_kN THEN
                rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN := rMaxTensionerTrimAuthority_kN;
            ELSIF rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN < -500.0 THEN
                rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN := -500.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Dynamic State Transition Checks *)
        IF rStressUtilization_Pct > 80.0 THEN
            iState := 30; (* High Current Bending Surge *)
        ELSIF rState_x2_LeakRate < -0.25 THEN
            iState := 40; (* Buoyancy Module Nitrogen Depletion Leak *)
        ELSIF (iHealthySensorCount <= 1) OR NOT bAcousticTelemetryLinkOk THEN
            iState := 50; (* Sensor Redundancy Loss / Degraded Fallback *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_HIGH_CURRENT_BENDING_SURGE: Loop current or severe hydrodynamic deflection *)
        bSystemReady                 := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive          := TRUE;
        bEmergencyDisconnectAdvisory := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord            := 16#0030;
        wAlarmWord.5                 := TRUE; (* Bending Stress Exceedance Warning *)
        udiTotalStressExceedanceEvents := udiTotalStressExceedanceEvents + 1;

        (* Maximize Tensioner Trim Authority to tension out bending moments *)
        IF bAutoTensionerTrimEnable THEN
            rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN := rMaxTensionerTrimAuthority_kN;
        END_IF;

        (* Escalation and Recovery *)
        IF rStressUtilization_Pct > 105.0 THEN
            (* Plastic yield / extreme buckle hazard: Trigger disconnect sequence *)
            iState := 99;
        ELSIF (rStressUtilization_Pct < 70.0) AND (rInclinometerAngle_deg < 2.2) THEN
            wAlarmWord.5 := FALSE;
            iState := 20; (* Return to Normal State *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_N2_PRESSURE_LEAK_DEGRADATION: Diaphragm rupture or micro-leak tracking *)
        bSystemReady                 := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive          := TRUE;
        bEmergencyDisconnectAdvisory := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord            := 16#0040;
        wAlarmWord.6                 := TRUE; (* Nitrogen Leak Rate Alarm *)

        (* Augment Top Tension to replace lost buoyant uplift *)
        IF bAutoTensionerTrimEnable THEN
            rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN := (rNominalPreCharge_bar - rVotedN2Pressure_bar) * 6.5;
            IF rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN > rMaxTensionerTrimAuthority_kN THEN
                rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN := rMaxTensionerTrimAuthority_kN;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        tonLeakPersistenceTimer(IN := (rVotedN2Pressure_bar < (rHydrostatic_Filt_bar * 0.90)), PT := T#15S);
        IF tonLeakPersistenceTimer.Q THEN
            (* Catastrophic loss of module integrity: Module flooded *)
            wAlarmWord.7 := TRUE; (* Flooded Module Critical Alarm *)
            iState := 50;
        ELSIF rState_x2_LeakRate >= -0.05 THEN
            wAlarmWord.6 := FALSE;
            iState := 20;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_DEGRADED_TELEMETRY_FALLBACK: Acoustic blackout or sensor loss *)
        bSystemReady                 := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive          := TRUE;
        bEmergencyDisconnectAdvisory := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord            := 16#0050;
        wAlarmWord.8                 := TRUE; (* Telemetry Redundancy Depleted *)

        (* Safe open-loop tensioner setpoint based on drill string weight and static riser schedule *)
        rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN := (rDrillStringWeight_kN * 0.12) + 250.0;

        (* Recovery condition: Minimum 2 sensors restored and acoustic link healthy *)
        IF (iHealthySensorCount >= 2) AND bAcousticTelemetryLinkOk AND (rTelemetryBitErrorRate_Pct < 10.0) THEN
            wAlarmWord.8 := FALSE;
            iState := 20;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_DISCONNECT_ADVISORY: Critical yield limit or physical buckle alert *)
        bSystemReady                 := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive          := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDisconnectAdvisory := TRUE; (* Active Trip Demand to DP System / EDS *)
        rRecommendedTopTensionTrim_kN:= rMaxTensionerTrimAuthority_kN;
        wSystemStatusWord            := 16#9999;
        wAlarmWord.1                 := TRUE; (* Critical Stress / Disconnect Command *)

        (* Latch state until master safety permissive is revoked and reset *)
        IF NOT bEStopDisconnectPermissive THEN
            wAlarmWord.1 := FALSE;
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 6: ISA-18.2 SECONDARY ALARM HIERARCHY & STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY LIMITS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Palmgren-Miner Cumulative Fatigue Threshold Alarm *)
IF rCumulativeFatigueDamage_Miner > 0.85 THEN
    wAlarmWord.9 := TRUE;  (* Critical Riser Joint Fatigue Consumption *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.9 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Flex Joint Severe Angular Excursion Trip (> 4.0 deg threshold) *)
IF rInclinometerAngle_deg > 4.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.10 := TRUE; (* Excessive Subsea Joint Deflection Angle *)
    bEmergencyDisconnectAdvisory := TRUE;
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.10 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic Link Packet Loss / High Noise Alert *)
IF rTelemetryBitErrorRate_Pct > 20.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.11 := TRUE; (* High Acoustic BER Interference *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.11 := FALSE;
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
